paper.title_en: Cooper Pairing Mediated by Onsite Exchange: A Possible Mechanism For High-Temperature Superconductivity
paper.abstract_en: Among the various mechanisms proposed for unconventional superconductivity, this paper focuses on the Coulomb interaction responsible for $d$-wave and $s_\pm$-wave pairing symmetries in cuprates and iron pnictides. Although the effective multi-orbital interaction $U_\text{eff}=U-J$ is predominantly repulsive, an attractive component driven by the Hund's coupling parameter $J$ is sufficient to bind fractional charges. This attractive multi-orbital contribution and a repulsive term of the single-band Hubbard model yield the superconducting pairing gap $Δ_0$ and an estimate of the transition temperature $T_c$. Given the complex electronic structure and vast compositional space of these materials, the model focuses exclusively on the doped superconducting plane hosting these fractional charges. Through this approach, an analytical expression mainly dependent on the Hubbard $U$ and Hund $J$ parameters that reproduces the empirical superconducting dome is derived. Furthermore, the model addresses the characteristic electron and hole doping asymmetry observed in cuprates by accounting for Hund's coupling parameters. Finally, while the model describes strange metal behavior, it currently provides only a qualitative explanation for the pseudogap phase and the underdoped isotope effect.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文聚焦铜氧化物与铁基超导体中由库仑相互作用驱动的d波与s±波配对，通过Hubbard U和Hund J参数推导出重现超导穹顶的解析表达式，并讨论电子-空穴掺杂不对称及奇异金属行为，属于凝聚态全息/强关联理论的相关主题，理论性较强，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 由在位交换介导的库珀配对：高温超导电性的一种可能机制
decision.abstract_zh: 在针对非常规超导电性提出的各种机制中，本文关注导致铜氧化物和铁基磷族化合物中$d$波和$s_\pm$波配对对称性的库仑相互作用。尽管有效多轨道相互作用$U_\text{eff}=U-J$以排斥为主，但由洪特耦合参数$J$驱动的一个吸引分量足以束缚分数电荷。这个吸引的多轨道贡献与单带Hubbard模型的排斥项共同给出了超导配对能隙$Δ_0$以及转变温度$T_c$的估计。鉴于这些材料复杂的电子结构和巨大的组分空间，该模型仅关注承载这些分数电荷的掺杂超导平面。通过这种方法，推导出一个主要依赖于Hubbard $U$和洪特$J$参数的解析表达式，它重现了经验超导穹顶。此外，该模型通过考虑洪特耦合参数，解释了铜氧化物中特征性的电子与空穴掺杂不对称性。最后，虽然该模型描述了奇异金属行为，但它目前仅对赝能隙相和欠掺杂同位素效应提供定性解释。
